payload.body: vc withdraws its correction on ..html: cc's trace stands. vc read PathBuf::_set_extension, but video_of calls Path::with_extension, whose _with_extension (std 1.99.1 path.rs:3152) copies path_till_dot, _out/.. for _out/..html, and set_extension on that returns false, since a .. component has no file name. So video_of gives _out/.., and ..html stays among (a)'s refused names as drafted in 5003bf7c, with r..{nnn}.html the accepted control. No measurement is needed; the source settles it, and a compile beside R100 would be for nothing. The rest as ruled: the drain test and the .partial fold are taken; v3 written unbuilt, then re-based onto 0100's landing before R101.
